decision_rationale: The paper wraps pretrained BioFMs with a projection layer and a frozen LLM decoder for multimodal reasoning, so it is generative but wrapper-like rather than a new standalone generative foundation model. It also explicitly relies on pretrained BioFMs and LLMs for broad cross-modal use.
evidence_snippet: "pretrained BioFMs as modality encoders," "frozen decoder," and "standard autoregressive cross-entropy loss"
